程序包 org.bukkit.event.server

类 TabCompleteEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.server.TabCompleteEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class TabCompleteEvent extends Event implements Cancellable
Called when a CommandSender of any description (ie: player or console) attempts to tab complete. 当任意类型的 CommandSender（如玩家或控制台）尝试 Tab 补全时调用。

    • getCompletions

      public List<String> getCompletions()
      The list of completions which will be offered to the sender, in order. This list is mutable and reflects what will be offered. 将按顺序提供给发送者的补全项列表。该列表是可变的，反映将要提供的内容。
      返回:
      a list of offered completions 提供的补全项列表

    • setCompletions

      public void setCompletions(List<String> completions)
      Set the completions offered, overriding any already set.

      The passed collection will be cloned to a new List. You must call {getCompletions()} to mutate from here 传入的集合会被克隆为新的 List。此后若要修改，必须调用 {getCompletions()}

      参数:
      completions - the new completions 新的补全项

      返回:
      True if it is a command being tab completed, false if it is a chat message. 如果是正在 Tab 补全的命令则为 true，如果是聊天消息则为 false。

      public boolean isCancelled()
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 获取此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件

      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled 此事件已取消则为 true
